title: Gated stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1, two 55-bit VA ranges, at 123.292844044870432

claims.statement: Gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search (proof.md) recovers x from uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O gives x=0). Coordinator 0 halts with no output unless a 128-bit RNDR u < K_GATE = 132776513122088019763758432322681505828 (p_gate ~ 0.390195103); else Phase-0 X-mining (E_mine <= 2^123.8952 insns; no output if a pool has < 4 valid pairs), then q1 = 103,000,000,000 batches in G = 10752 groups on 2^66 generators, 2^40 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960). lo_run >= 0.999499986696, (K_GATE/2^128) lo_run >= 0.39. E_total = 256 + p_gate E_run <= 2^123.292844044870432 units of 1000 AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.650577 units, <= 58.2129 insns/leaf of S = 2^128.753096); memory <= 2^137.9998 B; pre <= 2^116.2734 units; no advice; rendezvous transport (messages read in place, no copies or queues; proof.md 5.1).

experiments.purpose: Checks leaf, Phase-0 and routing kernels on the two-55-bit-VA-range machine (incl. VA-0 wraps), rendezvous replay vs in-place delivery, gate, C132 bound and counts.
